about_short_description.short_description: Ryvn helps companies deploy, monitor, and manage applications in customer clouds.

product.name: Customer Cloud Deployment
product.description: Enables deployment of applications directly into customer cloud accounts on AWS, GCP, or Azure with minimal configuration.

product.name: On-Premises Deployment Support
product.description: Supports deployment and management of applications in on-premises environments without requiring specialized DevOps expertise.

product.name: Provisioning Infrastructure and Environment Management
product.description: Provides automated provisioning of infrastructure including dedicated VPCs, Kubernetes clusters, and environment configurations for application deployment.

product.name: CI/CD and Release Pipelines
product.description: Automates continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows, enabling code deployment across multiple environments with support for rollbacks and gradual releases.

product.name: Observability and Monitoring
product.description: Offers centralized monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed applications, including real-time metrics and health checks.

product.name: Security and Compliance Controls
product.description: Delivers enterprise-grade security features including isolated networking, audit trails, and compliance support for regulatory requirements.
